target: compiled workstream packet freshness for chat-native-control-plane-v1
acceptance: Compiled work packet reflects latest durable FOCUS/frontier and last-return evidence, or exposes explicit freshness/staleness so fresh workers cannot mistake prepared-only projection for live state.
title: Expose or eliminate stale compiled workstream projection
mission: Make the compiled chat-native-control-plane packet truthfully distinguish its older prepared/last-return snapshot from the live S1 swarm frontier, preferably by compiling current durable frontier evidence or by carrying an explicit freshness/staleness boundary. Add a regression check so fresh workers cannot silently treat an old prepared-only projection as current operational state.

goal_relevance.reason: Fresh disposable workers depend on compiled runtime orientation being clearly bounded from live frontier truth.

human_friction_reduction.reason: A truthful freshness marker reduces the chance that a replacement chat asks the human to reconstruct why durable state appears to regress from active S1 back to prepared-only.

regression_prevention.reason: Current compiled packet still carries PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT_DEFINED_FIRST_BATCH_PREPARED and a 00:12 prepared-canary last_return while FOCUS records materially active S1 execution and later durable returns.

falsification: If the compiled packet is intentionally a historical baseline and every supported bootstrap is already mechanically forced to load newer FOCUS/Continuity before making any current-state claim, then the correct fix may be an explicit historical_snapshot/freshness boundary plus a test rather than synchronizing live swarm state into the packet.
